items.desc: Each year of his ​presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment at his failure ​to win the prize.

items.title: Traffic halted after Lokaha bridge sinks on Mahendra Highway
items.desc: Traffic has been diverted after the middle section of a 50-year-old iron bridge on the Narayangadh–Kawasoti road sagged, raising fears it could collapse.

items.title: After the storm in Nagoya, Arika Gurung searches for her sun
items.desc: Gurung, ranked ninth in the world, carried Nepal’s golden dream to Japan and returned empty-handed. In a candid reflection, she breaks down her darkest defeat and the quiet resolve driving her comeback.

items.title: Explainer: How are airfares set in Nepal, and who regulates them?
items.desc: Airfares depend on demand, seat availability, operating costs and competition. While domestic fares must stay within prescribed limits, international ticket prices are largely determined by market forces and bilateral air service agreements.

items.title: India detains hundreds, locks down Delhi to foil election chief protest

items.title: Bhatta’s paper trail leads to court for the sixth time

items.title: Selective buying offers little lift to Nepse as turnover declines
items.desc: Banking shares gained, and hydropower stocks dominated trading, but weak turnover and losses across most sectors point to limited investor confidence.

items.title: Mass detentions, journalist arrests as Delhi police move to block protest
items.desc: Authorities closed Metro stations, restricted movement and detained organisers, journalists and lawyers ahead of a youth-led protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.

items.title: Indian police detain ‘cockroach’ movement founder Abhijeet Dipke
items.desc: Dipke and two other CJP leaders were detained ahead of a planned youth-led protest demanding the resignation of India’s chief election commissioner, which authorities had banned.

items.title: Congress reins pass to Gagan Thapa and Bishwa Prakash Sharma
items.desc: Thapa’s election as president and Sharma’s unopposed rise as senior vice-president mark a generational shift, but the pair inherit a party still divided by factional rivalries and an entrenched political culture.

items.title: Nabin Raj Basnet arrested in 13-year-old sandalwood smuggling case
items.desc: The arrest comes amid a wider investigation into Basnet’s alleged links with people close to former chief justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana and suspected judicial middlemen.

items.desc: Police have barricaded roads, detained youth leaders and tightened security, as the home ministry urges states to stop protesters travelling to Delhi.

items.title: In ‘Shree Bijjo Bhoot’, a daughter’s search and a mother’s wait
items.desc: Blending local folklore, humour and music, the play tells a story of absence and longing while questioning how society judges men and women differently.

items.title: Musk taunts Ambani over Starlink’s entry into India
items.desc: The SpaceX chief accuses the Indian billionaire of protecting his market dominance, arguing that satellite internet could connect underserved communities and expand access to education and global markets.

items.title: Nepal’s gold-smuggling networks survive crackdown after crackdown
items.desc: Investigations have exposed major syndicates and implicated police officers, yet high profits and gaps in the legal supply of gold continue to fuel the trade.

items.desc: A study of 584 children living in holding centres in Kathmandu, Nuwakot and Rasuwa finds that 41 had lost both parents, 161 their fathers and 67 their mothers.

items.desc: An investigation found that Dahal had acted in breach of conduct rules after he allegedly visited former chief justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana without authorisation.

items.title: Storms and heavy rain devastate crops across western Nepal
items.desc: Farmers in Kailali, Bardiya, Salyan and Dang have suffered losses to paddy, fruits, and vegetables, raising fears of lower yields and increasing demands for government relief.

items.title: Oman’s win over Canada gives Nepal a boost in League 2 race
items.desc: Oman beat Canada by 41 runs in Muscat, easing Nepal’s battle for a top-six finish in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2.

items.title: Indian youth leader says protest will go ahead despite detentions
items.desc: Abhijeet Dipke vows to march in New Delhi despite reported detentions of thousands of supporters over a voter-list revision that opposition parties say has disenfranchised millions.

items.title: Thousands of flood-displaced children remain out of reach of measles vaccination
items.desc: Health officials have indefinitely stalled vaccination in three flood-hit districts, warning that displaced children face a heightened risk of infectious disease outbreaks.
